summary: The note is a short biographical entry on Moinuddin Ahmed Chowdhury, covering his education. It states he passed his matriculation examination from Dinajpur Zilla School in 1937, earned a B.A. from Ripon College, Kolkata in 1942, and later a master's degree in Islamic History from the University of Calcutta in 1945.
one_line: Biographical note on Moinuddin Ahmed Chowdhury's education: Dinajpur Zilla School, Ripon College Kolkata, and a University of Calcutta master's in Islamic History.
key_facts: Moinuddin Ahmed Chowdhury passed his matriculation examination from Dinajpur Zilla School in 1937.
Moinuddin Ahmed Chowdhury acquired his B.A. degree in 1942 from Ripon College, Kolkata.
Moinuddin Ahmed Chowdhury later acquired a master's degree in Islamic History from the University of Calcutta in 1945.
Moinuddin Ahmed Chowdhury's matriculation examination was passed at Dinajpur Zilla School.
Moinuddin Ahmed Chowdhury's bachelor's degree was a B.A. obtained from Ripon College in Kolkata.
Moinuddin Ahmed Chowdhury's master's degree was in Islamic History.
Moinuddin Ahmed Chowdhury's master's degree was awarded by the University of Calcutta.
The master's degree of Moinuddin Ahmed Chowdhury was acquired in 1945, three years after his B.A.
